en: A distinctive smell, especially a pleasant one; also a trail followed by an animal.
ex: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
新鮮麵包的香味充滿了廚房。

en: Very unusual or surprising; much greater than normal.
ex: She showed extraordinary courage during the crisis.
她在危機中展現了非凡的勇氣。

en: A particular type of art, music or literature, with its own typical features.
ex: Science fiction is my favorite genre.
科幻小說是我最喜歡的類型。

en: A large flat pad that you lie on as part of a bed.
ex: I need a new mattress because my back hurts.
我需要一張新床墊，因為我背痛。

en: The traditions, buildings and values passed down from earlier generations.
ex: The old town is part of our cultural heritage.
這座老城是我們文化遺產的一部分。

en: To announce something publicly or officially.
ex: The king proclaimed a national day of mourning.
國王宣布了全國哀悼日。

en: Extremely good; wonderful (informal); or belonging to legend.
ex: We had a fabulous holiday in Italy.
我們在義大利度過了一個絕佳的假期。

en: The bony structure of the head that protects the brain.
ex: The helmet protected his skull in the crash.
頭盔在撞擊中保護了他的頭骨。

en: A computer or program that provides data or services to other computers; or a person who serves food.
ex: The server crashed and the website went offline.
伺服器當機，網站離線了。

en: A political and economic system in which property is owned by the community, not by individuals.
ex: Communism collapsed in Eastern Europe in 1989.
共產主義在1989年於東歐瓦解。

en: A supporting structure, or a set of rules and ideas used as a basis for decisions.
ex: The new law provides a framework for reform.
新法為改革提供了架構。

en: The ability to speak or write a language easily and well.
ex: Her fluency in French helped her get the job.
她流利的法語幫她得到了這份工作。

en: To climb onto something, or to increase gradually; also a mountain or a frame for display.
ex: Tension began to mount as the deadline approached.
隨著截止日期臨近，緊張氣氛逐漸升高。

en: To push something suddenly and with force; also the main point or force of something.
ex: He thrust the letter into my hand and left.
他把信塞進我手裡就離開了。

en: The state of being completely sure; something that is definitely true.
ex: I can say with certainty that he was there.
我可以確定地說他當時在那裡。

en: A particular form of something that differs from other forms; or one person's account of an event.
ex: Please download the latest version of the app.
請下載該應用程式的最新版本。

en: A sudden feeling of excitement and pleasure; or to excite someone greatly.
ex: The roller coaster gave the children a big thrill.
雲霄飛車讓孩子們感到非常刺激。

en: To look through information, shops or websites casually; or to graze on plants.
ex: I like to browse in bookstores on weekends.
我週末喜歡在書店隨意翻閱。

en: Great love or loyalty toward a person, cause or religion.
ex: Her devotion to her patients was admired by all.
她對病患的奉獻受到所有人的欽佩。

en: A small church or a room used for Christian worship in a school or hospital.
ex: They got married in a small chapel by the sea.
他們在海邊的小教堂結婚。

en: A chair with large wheels, used by people who cannot walk.
ex: The building has a ramp for wheelchair users.
這棟建築為輪椅使用者設有斜坡。

en: Very impressive or exciting to look at.
ex: The fireworks display was absolutely spectacular.
煙火表演實在壯觀極了。

en: Relating to the mental processes of thinking, knowing and remembering.
ex: Reading improves children's cognitive development.
閱讀能促進兒童的認知發展。

en: A statement that something is not true, or a refusal to accept something.
ex: The minister issued a firm denial of the rumors.
部長堅決否認了這些謠言。

en: To become or make something softer, gentler or less severe.
ex: Add some cream to soften the taste of the sauce.
加一些奶油來緩和醬汁的味道。

en: A person or thing used in place of another; or to use or put in place of another.
ex: You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.
這道食譜中你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

en: Relating to the sea; or a soldier who serves on ships.
ex: The marine biologist studies coral reefs.
那位海洋生物學家研究珊瑚礁。

en: A person who watches something carefully, or who follows a rule.
ex: Observers say the election was fair.
觀察員表示選舉是公平的。

en: A strong belief or opinion; or a decision in court that someone is guilty.
ex: He spoke with deep conviction about the issue.
他對這個議題深信不疑地發言。

en: Easy to understand or do; or honest and direct.
ex: The application process is quite straightforward.
申請程序相當簡單明瞭。

en: An official order or authority to do something, given by voters or a higher body.
ex: The voters gave the new president a clear mandate.
選民給了新總統明確的授權。

en: Pressure or stress; to injure a muscle by stretching it; or to make an effort.
ex: The long hours put a strain on his health.
長時間工作對他的健康造成負擔。

en: To officially end a law, system or practice.
ex: Many countries have abolished the death penalty.
許多國家已經廢除了死刑。

en: Relating to the relationships between living things and their environment.
ex: The oil spill caused serious ecological damage.
漏油事件造成嚴重的生態破壞。

en: Goods carried by ships, trains or planes; or the cost of transporting them.
ex: The freight was delivered to the port on Monday.
貨物星期一運抵港口。

en: The complete loss of hope; or to lose all hope.
ex: She wept in despair when she heard the news.
她聽到消息後絕望地哭了。

en: Unfriendly and showing a wish to fight or oppose.
ex: The crowd was hostile toward the speaker.
群眾對演講者懷有敵意。

en: Being the last or most extreme of its kind; or the best possible example.
ex: Our ultimate goal is to reduce waste to zero.
我們的最終目標是把浪費降到零。

en: To attract and hold someone's interest very strongly.
ex: The magic show fascinated the children.
魔術表演讓孩子們著迷。

en: An idea or statement taken as the basis for an argument; or (plural) a building and its land.
ex: The argument rests on a false premise.
這個論點建立在錯誤的前提上。
